title: Counter action on a configuration
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and form a clock configuration from a $W$-configuration $c$, a buffer tape $\tau$, buffer-head position $z$, fixed contents and head positions for the $K$ work tapes, clock state $st$, and output word. Applying a counter action that writes the optional value $w$ at the buffer head, moves that head by $d$, and sets the state to $q$ produces the clock configuration with state $q$, buffer tape unchanged if $w$ is absent and otherwise updated to $w$ at $z$, buffer-head position $z+d$, and all other listed components unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: fixed contents function for the $K$ work tapes
fixed head-position function for the $K$ work tapes
